entries.010453d19dc0ebab: The Professional segment accounts for 70.6% of revenue, and interior finishing equipment and tatami manufacturing equipment are the core of the business. The residential-related market, its main market, performed weakly due to persistently high construction costs and rising mortgage interest rates, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 fell 2.2% year on year to ¥9,569 million. On the other hand, the Industry segment recorded lower revenue due to a gap between large projects, while the New Industry segment grew 27.3% year on year, driven by strong demand from the automotive-related industry.

entries.200dfe96b8335d3e: In October 2023 it changed its name to KLASS Corporation, and has rebuilt its philosophy system to promote its CI and branding. Its core direction is to develop into a '2.4-sector' type enterprise, aiming to expand its business by leveraging intangible assets accumulated as a manufacturer, such as sales channels, customer base, IT systems and equipment design and development technology, to grow businesses providing not only hardware but also software and services. It states that in the Professional segment it will expand market share through development of models that improve the usability of its main automatic wallpaper pasting machines and through structural reform proposals to tatami shops; in the Industry segment it will respond to inquiries for secondary battery manufacturing equipment and decarbonization-related equipment; and in the New Industry segment, through ROSECC, it will open up markets through synergies between robot control technology and its core technologies.
entries.20d9d946b2e81134: Its distinguishing feature is that, built on seven elemental technologies accumulated through developing tatami manufacturing equipment and interior finishing equipment ('sewing', 'cutting', 'length measurement', 'coating', 'peeling', 'folding' and 'measurement'), it can extend into equipment development in other fields such as secondary battery manufacturing equipment and food equipment. The cumulative number of patents granted reaches 427, and its assembly plants, including an ISO Class 6-equivalent clean plant, can also assemble semiconductor-related equipment and large secondary battery manufacturing equipment. For tatami shops, it conducts a proprietary sales approach called 'structural reform proposals', which proposes modernization of management through the introduction of tatami manufacturing systems.
